title: AgentFrontmatterSchema
description: Validation schema for YAML frontmatter in .agents/agents/*.md

name.description: Unique agent identifier in kebab-case, matching the filename stem.

role.description: Formal technical role title (e.g., Presentation Layer Architect).

description.description: Comprehensive role summary, boundaries, and mandate.

mode.description: Operating execution mode of the agent persona.

allowed_tools.description: Explicit list of allowed tool names.

forbidden_tools.description: Explicit list of forbidden tool names.
